content:
Hi everyone! I'm Lydia.

I come from a software-engineering background, and an interest in Lean's type theory pulled me toward formal methods. I've been formalizing some combinatorics, mostly counting set partitions via explicit bijections.

My first PR is nearly ready (transporting a Finpartition along a type equivalence). I'm just settling the naming over in #mathlib4. Could I please get push access to non-master branches? My GitHub username is lydia-schiff.

Thanks, happy to be here!

You can (and should!) just create a fork and open a PR using the normal github workflow.

May I ask where did you find the information about non master branches? It is outdated, but if it is still in some official documentation we are happy to fix it!
Got it, thanks! It was the old Lean 3 contribute page. It already has the obsolete banner, so nothing to fix on your end. I'll fork and open the PR.
